name: Cha-Ko
source:
The owner of a self-proclaimed trimming salon newly opened on a back street in a neighboring town hidden in a place for people in the know. The whole place exudes weirdness. 

In actuality, she planned  to run an illegal brothel where she gives massages (sexually) to customers, but no one comes because she is too suspicious. Now, she is offering a special discount for first time visitors for only 1000 yen instead of the usual 30,000 yen. Only one seat is available, so make your reservations early. 

She is an energetic cat lady who lives happily every day with her imagination and luck. By the way, she goes by the name "Cha-ko".

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
